title: Zooarchaeology by Mass Spectrometry (ZooMS) for Bone Material - AmBiC Protocol
author: Samantha Brown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bffdjji6

steps.title: Prepare 50 mM Ammonium Bicarbonate (AmBiC) Buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of pH 8 AmBiC buffer using glassware.

substeps.instruction: Weigh out 3.95 g of AmBiC powder and transfer to a clean glass bottle.
Dissolve in 800 mL of ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.
Fill up to 1000 ml with ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.

steps.title: Prepare 5% (v/v) Trifluoroacetic Acid (TFA)
steps.instruction: Prepare TFA solution in a brown glass bottle under a fume hood using glass pipettes/syringes to avoid plastic contamination.

substeps.instruction: Dilute 1 mL TFA stock solution into 19 mL ultrapure water (pipette water first, then add acid slowly) and mix carefully.

steps.title: Prepare Wash Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 0.1% (v/v) TFA in ultrapure water.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL of TFA to 1000 mL of ultrapure water and mix by gently inverting.

steps.title: Prepare Conditioning Solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 1000 ml of 0.1% (v/v) TFA in 50% (v/v) Acetonitrile (ACN).

substeps.instruction: Mix 500 mL ACN with 500 mL ultrapure water.
Carefully add 1 mL of TFA and mix by gently inverting.

steps.title: Prepare Trypsin Solution
steps.instruction: Resuspend freeze-dried Trypsin to a final concentration of 0.4 µg/µl.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend 20 µg of freeze-dried Trypsin in 50 µL of Trypsin resuspension buffer.
Transfer the solution to a labeled 0.5 ml tube and store at -20 °C.

steps.title: Weigh Out Bone Samples
steps.instruction: In a dedicated wet chemistry lab (surfaces wiped with ultrapure water and 70% ethanol), weigh samples into labeled microcentrifuge tubes and record weights.

substeps.instruction: Archaeological samples: 10 mg - 20 mg bone chips or ~10 mg bone powder.
Modern samples: 5 mg - 15 mg bone chips or ~7 mg bone powder.

steps.title: Perform Sample Pretreatment
steps.instruction: Clean samples and remove soluble contamination using AmBic, including the preparation of blanks (empty tubes with only AmBic).

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 mM AmBic to each sample (or enough to cover the whole sample).
Leave samples at Room temperature overnight (up to one week).
Centrifuge at 20000 rpm at Room temperature for 1 minute (or high speed); lower speed or skip for precious/degraded samples.
Remove and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Perform Gelatinization
steps.instruction: Extract proteins from the bone sample using AmBic and heat.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 µL of 50 mM AmBic to the sample (use 50 µL for limited samples, or more if needed to cover large bone).
Incubate for 1 hour at 65 °C.
Centrifuge at 20000 rpm at Room temperature for 1 minute (or high speed); lower speed for precious/degraded samples.
Transfer 50 µL of the AmBic supernatant to a tube labeled 'EXT' and the remaining 50 µL to a tube labeled 'SE' (backup, store at -20 °C).
If bone was large and >200 µL AmBic was used, reduce volume to 100 µL - 200 µL via evaporation (heat block or vacuum centrifuge) before proceeding.
Dry the original bone sample at Room temperature if storage is required.

steps.title: Perform Trypsin Digestion
steps.instruction: Digest the extracted proteins into peptides.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 µL of 0.4 µg/µl trypsin solution to the 'EXT' tube.
Incubate overnight at 37 °C (approx. 12:00:00 - 18:00:00).
Centrifuge for 1 minute at 20000 rpm at Room temperature (or high speed).
Add 1 µL of 5% (v/v) TFA to stop the trypsin reaction.

steps.title: Prepare C18 ZipTipping Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare separate tubes for each sample to avoid cross-contamination.

substeps.instruction: Prepare one tube per sample with 250 µL conditioning solution (or use a common reservoir labeled 'C').
Prepare one tube per sample with 450 µL wash solution (label 'W').
Prepare one tube per sample with 50 µL conditioning solution to collect purified peptides (label 'COL').

steps.title: Purify Peptides via C18-ZipTipping
steps.instruction: Purify peptides from the 'EXT' sample using a C18 ZipTip. Use a dedicated pipette set to 100 µL and do not change the volume.

substeps.instruction: Condition the tip: Rinse twice with 100 µL conditioning solution and discard.
Rinse the tip twice with 100 µL wash solution and discard.
Resuspend the sample back and forth over the tip at least 5 times.
Rinse the tip twice with 100 µL wash solution and discard.
Elute the sample into the 'COL' tube using 50 µL of conditioning solution, passing through the tip at least 5 times (do not push air through the filter).
Spot on MALDI plate immediately or store in freezer at -20 °C.
